evidence: Substantially alters assumeutxo snapshot processing, txdb coin serialization, and LevelDB writing in loadtxoutset.
rationale: Substantially optimizes assumeutxo snapshot loading by replacing the sequential import path with a parallelized LevelDB pipeline. According to the author, this avoids redundant staging into CCoinsViewCache and eliminates fsync write gating, directly speeding up initial node readiness during snapshot imports.
